title: Store Settings
subtitle: Global configuration and management
desc: Manage core store configurations, payments, shipping, and advanced options.

general.title: Store Identity
general.desc: Update basic store information and branding.

seo.title: SEO Settings
seo.desc: Optimize your store visibility in search results.

social.title: Social Media
social.desc: Link your store to your social accounts.

contact.title: Contact Info
contact.businessAddressDesc: Company address details and registration info.

bankTransfer.title: Bank Transfer Details
bankTransfer.desc: Add your bank account details to be shown to customers when they choose to pay via bank transfer.

shipping.title: Shipping & Taxes
shipping.vatWarning: Note: These settings will be ignored if specific tax rules are defined in the Taxes section.

features.title: Store Features
features.desc: Enable or disable core features and functionalities.
features.reviewsDesc: Allow customers to write reviews on products.
features.couponsDesc: Enable the use of discount codes and coupons.
features.guestCheckoutDesc: Allow customers to checkout without an account.
features.wishlistDesc: Allow customers to save products to their wishlist.

advanced.title: Advanced Options
advanced.inventoryAlertsDesc: Enable low stock alerts when adding items to cart.
advanced.performanceDesc: Display page speed and database performance.
advanced.clearCacheDesc: Rebuild internal cache for images, categories, and settings.
advanced.storageProviderDesc: Select where new uploaded images and files will be stored.
advanced.storageLocalDesc: Store files on the local server disk (Default).
advanced.storageCloudinaryDesc: Store files on Cloudinary Cloud and Global CDN.
